reason: We've run on our current system for years, the vendor knows us and it works well enough. Switching means migrating 550 members, retraining volunteers and getting a lot of people over 60 to install yet another app, and that's a lot of grief for a small volunteer board to take on for software that isn't live anywhere yet, built by two founders.
objection: Our older members won't install and use a new app, and they won't log in with codes by e-mail. If half of them end up phoning the secretary to book a tee time, I've made things worse. On top of that, two founders and no club live yet: what happens to our member data and invoicing if they stop?
would_change_my_mind: Seeing a club like ours, 9 holes with older members, actually running on it for a full season with most members using the app, plus a guarantee that we can export everything and go back without losing data.
